summary: The word "manjaniq" refers to a siege engine, similar to the Roman Onager or balista. It was used to hurl projectiles.
lane: [ مَنْجَنِيقٌ منجنيق , as described in art. جنق (q. v.), seems to be the engine called by the Romans Onager: see Kitto's Pict. Bible, ii. 499: but was probably applied also to the balista. ]

headwords.def: اجنى أج أجنى أجني اجنى اجني جنى جنين آجن آجني آجنيي said of a tree, (S, K,) or of a palmtree, (Msb,) It had ripe fruit: (S:) or it attained to the time for the gathering of its fruit: (Msb:) or it attained to maturity: (K:) or, said of a tree, it had fruit to be gathered and eaten: and, said of fruit, it became ripe: (TA:) and, said of grass, or herbage, it became abundant. headwords.def: تَجَنَّىَ see 1. تجنّى عَلَيْهِ , (S, * K,) or تجنّى عليه َنْبًا , (TA,) (assumed tropical:) He accused him of a crime, an offence, or an injurious action, that he had not committed; (S, K;) i. e. he forged against him the charge of his having committed a crime, &c., he being guiltless [ thereof ]: (TA:) النَّجَنِّى being like التَّجَرُّمُ .
